topic.title: Hangman Step 4
topic.description: Completes the Hangman mechanics by adding a lives counter and ASCII art stages that update with each wrong guess.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Decrementing a lives counter on wrong guesses and indexing a stages list to display matching ASCII art.
learningNotes.challenges: Calculating the correct stage index from remaining lives.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Refactor into functions and then into a class for full Hangman.
